notes.title: Introducing Tournament Mode (Beta)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/abc833b9a92e2287bb72d826aa0627475b6c3eb2.gif[/img]

For everyone who's wanted to host a [i]Sprint Vector[/i] tournament at their home, school, or arcade, we've got good news: we've just added in a new LAN-based Tournament Mode (beta) that can support up to eight active racers and three spectators. Here's a guide for how to access it:

[b][u]Overview[/u][/b]
The Tournament Mode Build is a beta version of [i]Sprint Vector[/i] that contains the following additional features:
[list]
[*][b]LAN Mode[/b] - LAN Mode allows players to connect to each other over a Local Area Network (LAN), with one user acting as the “Host” and additional users acting as “Client.” LAN Mode supports up to eight active racers and three spectators.
[*][b]Spectator Mode (LAN Only)[/b] - Spectator Mode allows a player to connect to a race (via LAN) as a “Spectator,” who can cycle through each racer’s camera and a third-person view to watch the race.
[/list]

[b][u]Accessing the Tournament Mode Build (BETA)[/u][/b]
[olist]
[*]Find [i]Sprint Vector[/i] in your Steam Library under [b]VR[/b].
[*]Right-click [i]Sprint Vector​[/i] and select [b]PROPERTIES.[/b]
[*]Click the [b]BETAS[/b]​ tab at the top of the menu.
[*]Under the field that says “Select the beta you would like to opt into,” select “[b]tournament-mode - LAN Mode + Spectator Mode (BETA)[/b]”​ from the drop-down menu.
[*]Click the Close button on the PROPERTIES menu (no code is required). The entry for Sprint Vector in your Steam Library should now read “[b]Sprint Vector [tournament-mode][/b].”
[*]Launch [i]Sprint Vector[/i] through Steam. On launch, the player will be presented with three options:
[list]
[*]Launch [i]Sprint Vector[/i] in Steam VR Mode.
[*]Launch LAN-only [i]Sprint Vector[/i] in Steam VR Mode.
[*]Launch Spectator client for LAN games in Steam VR Mode.
[/list]
[*]Select the Launch Option for your desired version of [i]Sprint Vector[/i].
[/olist]

[b][u]Instructions for Beta Launch Options[/u][/b]

[b]Launch [i]Sprint Vector[/i] in Steam VR Mode[/b]
Launching this Beta version of [i]Sprint Vector[/i] in Steam VR Mode will launch the standard version of [i]Sprint Vector[/i]. However, users will not be able to access their save data from the main game, nor will they be able to connect to a multiplayer server. Survios strongly recommends that if you do not wish to use the LAN or Spectator modes that you access the main game through the main branch and not this beta version.

[b]Launch LAN-only [i]Sprint Vector[/i] in Steam VR Mode[/b]
Launching LAN-only [i]Sprint Vector[/i] in Steam VR Mode will launch [i]Sprint Vector[/i] in LAN mode. When playing through LAN mode, the Multiplayer tab in the main menu is replaced with a server browser though which players can either choose to host a game or select a server on their LAN to join. Please note that LAN mode only supports multiplayer games. Survios strongly discourages you from playing single-player races in LAN mode.

[b]Launch Spectator client for LAN games in Steam VR Mode[/b]
Launching [i]Sprint Vector[/i] in Spectator Mode will launch [i]Sprint Vector[/i] as a 2D desktop application rather than a 3D VR application. In addition to the game window, an additional window will launch called the “Admin Panel.” From the Admin Panel, players can select a server to join (LAN only), adjust video and audio settings, and quit the application.

[b]SPECTATOR CONTROLS:[/b]
[list]
[*][O]: Toggle Admin Panel
[*][+]/[-]: Cycle Racer View
[*][1]-[8]: Change Racer View by Position
[*][TAB]: Cycle Camera Modes
[*][F2]: Third Person Camera
[*][F3]: Tracking Camera
[*][F4]: Free Camera
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[b]Map Thumbnail Issue[/b] - In multiplayer LAN races, when selecting a new map to race on from the completion screen at the end of the race, the thumbnail icons for the selected course will not update for the Host. The intended course will still load properly, and this issue will not be replicated on clients.
[b]Single Player Saves[/b] - Single player saves are not supported in LAN or Spectator Mode.
[b]Host Black Screen[/b] - When playing in a multiplayer race in LAN mode, there is a very rare chance that the host of the multiplayer match will sit in a black screen upon finishing the race. If this occurs, the player should wait for a new match to load, at which point they should no longer be experiencing a black screen.
[/list]

[b]Support[/b]
Experiencing technical issues? Contact support@survios.com for help!

notes.title: A BIG BANG of Content: Sprint Vector Update 1.3 Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/86d2ee5d210634ef5526eca87c634878e23b63e0.png[/img]

Oh, you thought that [i]Sprint Vector[/i] couldn’t possibly get crazier, didn’t you? Hachi machi, aren’t you the absolute [i]most![/i]

In March’s Space Race Update, Mr. Entertainment surprised his contestants with an all-new course amid the glitz and glam (and gravity wells) of Outer Vegas, a luxury resort strategically positioned between two black holes where time stands still. But there’s no way you assumed he’d see those looming voids as just window dressing, right?

You’re about to find out, as the next stage of Sprint Vector heads into the heart of the neighboring Moebius 3-15 black hole itself! Yes, there’s a top secret research center nearby that’s probing into the singularity’s depths and has ruled it a no-fly zone..but who cares?! Who knows what weirdness awaits you on the other side? Think of the ratings! This is a map that’s truly worthy of its name: [b]Cosmic Odyssey![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TGGkAX5Zf4U
But that’s not all: two more contestants have thrown their cranial adornments into the Sprint Vector race in pursuit of their hearts’ desires, and their goals are lofty, to say the least:
[list]
[*]Joining Luna in the “space stuff gone sentient” category, [b]Rockslide[/b] is a comet who’s been exploring the vastness of space for millennia. Luckily, Mr. Entertainment has struck him a deal: if he wins, he gets a shiny new bipedal body (which he’s testing out here on the Sprint Vector tracks). But if he loses, Mr. E gains all the secrets of the known universe. You decide which option is better.
[*]As regal and stately as she is mysterious, [b]Necho[/b] contains multitudes within her half-machine body. Her name is that of a planet long consumed by its neighboring sun, whose doomed denizens fused their consciousnesses into their undying queen. She hopes that victory in [i]Sprint Vector[/i] will restore her long-lost home and allow the souls within her to live once more.
[/list]
Additionally, the update includes a change that many players will be stoked to hear: a new leaderboard mode! With [i]Sprint Vector[/i] increasingly gaining popularity as a VR speedrunner, we’re adding Pure Leaderboards for all maps, so players conducting solo runs without items and AI can compete against each other solely based on skill. To go along with the implementation of Pure Leaderboards, we’re conducting a complete wipe of all leaderboards. Now that the playing field is once again level, go forth and conquer!

The [i]Sprint Vector[/i] Big Bang Update is available now, made possible by Intel; thanks to them, all existing Sprint Vector players receive this update completely free of charge.

[b][i]Patch Notes for Update 1.3 (Released May 30, 2018)[/i][/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Map: Cosmic Odyssey[/b] – Players can now access the new map “Cosmic Odyssey” on both single player and multiplayer races.
[*][b]Additional Playable Characters[/b] – Players can now choose two additional playable characters, “Necho” and “Rockslide.”
[*][b]Leaderboard Update[/b] – In-game leaderboards have been reconfigured into three new race-only leaderboards: Single-Player, Multiplayer, and Pure. The Pure leaderboard ranks players’ on both single- and multiplayer races when racing in Competitive Mode with AI Racers and Power-Ups turned off.
[*][b]Animated Introduction[/b] – This patch adds the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JDm00CSHaKo]animated [i]Sprint Vector[/i] trailer[/url] to the game's launch sequence.
[*][b]Improved Stability[/b] – This patch includes several improvements to server and client stability and optimizations for performance to improve player experience.
[*][b]AI Pathing and Behavior[/b] – This patch includes several improvements to AI performance and behavior throughout the game.
[*][b]Improved Collision[/b] – This patch includes several improvements to collision volumes and path smoothing throughout the game.
[*][b]Improved Gripstream Performance[/b] – Players are now less likely to experience inconsistent positional data or 180-degree flipping when using gripstreams in multiplayer matches.
[*][b]General Graphical Performance Improvements[/b] – This patch contains several assorted adjustments to streaming volumes and distances to improve graphical performance.
[*][b]Oculus Slingshot Glitch[/b] – This patch fixes the "slingshot" movement exploit caused by the Oculus menu button.
[/list]

notes.title: Enter Now: Weekly Challenge #10--Mr. E's Master League Kicks Off in May!
notes.notes:
It’s the end of an era… [i]*sniffle*[/i] But as they say, when one door closes, another opens, and in this case that big fancy door leads to [b][i]MR. E’S MASTER LEAGUE![/i][/b] ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/731b29e1d2e39b34efe31f862b729fe990ebf798.png[/img]

Ahem. Got a bit excited there. We still have one final solo challenge to play us off, and we made this one a sendoff sure to generate extra style points! For week 10 and the last of our solo challenges, we’re making you run [b]the Gauntlet—and in Hardcore mode![/b]

You’ve got to get a faster time than 0:50:00 to qualify. Once you've hit your top time, [url=https://survios.com/sv-weekly-challenges-start-now/]enter using the form linked here[/url]!

(And remember, if you hit a snag, [url=discord.gg/survios]our always-active Discord community is here to share tips, tricks, and shortcuts in real time[/url].)

Entries must be submitted by [b]Sunday, April 22, at 11:59pm PST[/b] and are limited to [b]one per player.[/b] However, if you put up a better time after you've already submitted, don't fret: you can update your existing submission with it.

And since we can’t leave this mid-season finale without a cliffhanger, stay tuned for [i]Sprint Vector[/i] (and [i]Raw Data[/i]!) Happy Hour details coming next week, and the reassurance that the speedrunning competition you’ve been waiting for is just around the corner—Mr. E’s Master League will launch in May!

What are the Weekly Challenges, and why should you participate? First off, [i]everyone[/i] can enter regardless of system and platform: Steam, Oculus, and PSVR are all in it to win it. And not only do the Weekly Challenges encourage you to show us what you got on an assortment of maps and game modes, but a victory gives you a shot at participating in [b]Mr. E's Master League[/b], an upcoming community competition where only the speediest survive! You'll also earn [i]Vectorheads flair[/i] and an invite to [b]#mreswinnerscircle[/b], an exclusive Discord channel where the elite can mix and mingle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/00541ed22deeebf9ef82d4bfcc97294ad42dba5d.png[/img]

Since [i]Sprint Vector[/i]’s release in February, Vectorheads the universe over have been one-upping each other across the game’s twisty, tricky courses in a bid for lasting intergalactic glory. We’ve watched some truly amazing plays from these dedicated racers who’ve proved that with Fluid Locomotion, you can break the speed barrier in VR without losing your lunch.

But are they ready to take the competition to the next level…[i]in [b]space?![/b][/i]

https://youtu.be/1z6zwxfb1ro
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/654b4a0fca3575958c215897e517f940049efe81.png[/img]

[i]Sprint Vector[/i] mastermind Mr. Entertainment is thrilled to welcome our contestants to the newest frontier with the [b]Space Race Update[/b], featuring an all-new multiplayer map: [b]Outer Vegas![/b] And much like its namesake, this content drop comes with several opportunities to win...more details on that coming later this week!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/c725b31c1e7067bf97a59ee0f9b42a15b3169932.png[/img]

This luxury resort (dreamed into reality by our friends at ILF Labs) gives you all the glitz and glam you can handle without the needless annoyance of time! Thanks to its convenient positioning between two black holes, Outer Vegas’s intense time dilation lets you take a whole month or even year of rest and relaxation while only seconds pass outside the event horizon.

But that doesn’t mean our contestants get an easier time of it. With deadly drops off every turn, erratic gravity warps along the route, and an insane twist towards the end--literally--Outer Vegas is sure to send your blood pressure spiking as high as its colorful towers. It’s also riddled with shortcuts and alternate routes for those who love to jump and fly, but does the risk outweigh the reward? You’ll find out soon enough when you officially enter the Space Race!

Filled with complex lighting and visual effects, the space map was a labor of love for our artists and designers. Originally a cold, hard sci-fi-inspired course (think [i]Raw Data[/i]), everyone agreed the vibe wasn’t jiving with the rest of [i]Sprint Vector[/i]’s crazy-colorful aesthetic—until the day someone yelled “Space Vegas!” as a joke.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/bb097be8f1380f4f77af668c35ddadde4f4c2661.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/36e4c9f7a53a9a80342a99421454a8b5e5a35456.jpg[/img]

And it stuck. Soon, the chrome-heavy landscape was littered with glowing neon, vibrant lights, and even palm trees: Outer Vegas was a reality.

Additionally, the update includes ongoing gameplay stability improvements, AI behavior updates, and graphical performance upgrades to allow for a smoother sprinting experience overall across all solo and multiplayer maps (patch notes outlined below).

The Space Race Update is available now for free on Steam, Oculus Home, and PlayStation Network! This the first of a two-part sponsored content series made possible by Intel; thanks to them, all existing [i]Sprint Vector[/i] players will receive Outer Vegas and the other upcoming update completely free of charge. 

[b][u][i]Patch Notes for Update 1.2 (released April 3, 2018)[/i][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Map: Outer Vegas[/b] – “Outer Vegas” now live for both single-player and multiplayer races.
[*][b]Improved Multiplayer Loading[/b] – Players no longer get stuck at a black screen when loading into a multiplayer area.
[*][b]Improved Stability[/b] – Includes several improvements to server and client stability and optimizations for performance to improve player experience.
[*][b]AI Pathing and Behavior[/b] – Includes several improvements to AI performance and behavior throughout the game.
[*][b]Improved Collision[/b] – Includes several improvements to collision volumes and path smoothing throughout the game.
[*][b]Graphical Performance Improvements[/b] – Contains several assorted adjustments to streaming volumes and distances to improve graphical performance.
[/list]

[b][u][i]Known Issues[/i][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b][MULTIPLAYER][/b] On occasion, racers who complete the race will not be teleported to the Race Completion Zone.
[*][b][MULTIPLAYER][/b] Players who have been muted via the wrist menu may become unmuted when transitioning to a new map.
[*][b][MULTIPLAYER][/b] Players will sometimes lose speed lines and aim assist cones after passing through power-up orbs.
[*][b][MULTIPLAYER][/b] Players sometimes get stuck on an endless multiplayer loading screen. [i]Workaround: Bring up your Windows date and time settings to make sure that "Set time automatically" is turned on.[/i]
[*][b][OCULUS][/b] Oculus users experience strobe effect on loading screens. [i]Workaround: Turn on "Rift Core 2.0 Beta" found in the Beta tab of Oculus Home settings.[/i]
[*][b][PLAYSTATION][/b] Leaderboard scores are not currently updating on the final three challenge maps, Sidewinder, Blastoff and The Gauntlet. We are currently investigating this issue and intend to fix it with a patch as soon as possible.
[/list]

notes.title: Enter Now: Weekly Challenge #7!
notes.notes:
Greetings Vectorheads! Since you all got plenty of airtime last week, we’re bringing you down to earth this weekend with a classic challenge. And we expect you all to know the twists and turns of this map by <3 by now…no pressure.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/ea79c1c6129e81a47982e6a48b48c80306efc8ed.png[/img]

For our seventh week, you must navigate the [b]Sidewinder solo challenge map on Time Trial mode![/b]

We’re easing up on you guys a bit, too. You’ve got to get a faster time than 1:15:00 to qualify, so go practice those hairpin turns (or just fly over them, like you do). Once you've hit your top time, [url=https://survios.com/sv-weekly-challenges-start-now/]enter using the form linked here[/url]!

(And remember, if you hit a snag, [url=discord.gg/survios]our always-active Discord community is here to share tips, tricks, and shortcuts in real time[/url].)

Entries must be submitted by [b]Sunday, April 1, at 11:59pm PST (no fooling!)[/b] and are limited to [b]one per player.[/b] However, if you put up a better time after you've already submitted, don't fret: you can update your existing submission with it.

What are the Weekly Challenges, and why should you participate? First off, [i]everyone[/i] can enter regardless of system and platform: Steam, Oculus, and PSVR are all in it to win it. And not only do the Weekly Challenges encourage you to show us what you got on an assortment of maps and game modes, but a victory gives you a shot at participating in [b]Mr. E's Master League[/b], an upcoming community competition where only the speediest survive! You'll also earn [i]Vectorheads flair[/i] and an invite to [b]#mreswinnerscircle[/b], an exclusive Discord channel where the elite can mix and mingle.

notes.title: Help Us Troubleshoot--Send Us Your Issue Logs!
notes.notes:
Hey Vectorheads! While the big news from yesterday's [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/590690/announcements/detail/1675775070299587826]Racing with the Stars [i]Sprint Vector[/i] update[/url] was Mr. Entertainment and Princess Shran joining the race, there were also less paparazzi-worthy but no less important upgrades behind the scenes. And one of them requires your help!

Since the game launched, we've been working to squash as many bugs as possible, but we've had trouble recreating a lot of the reported issues here in the studio. That's why we implemented automatic issue log generation. If you encounter a bug in-game, we highly encourage you to send us the issue log so we can investigate further. Here's how you do it:
[olist]
[*]Make sure you've enabled "Show hidden files, folders, and drives" in your File Explorer Options.
[*]Navigate to C:\Users\*username*\AppData\Local\SprintVector\Saved\Logs to find the log.
[*]Send the log file to us by using [url=https://survios.com/sprintvector/support/]the official [i]Sprint Vector[/i] feedback form[/url], describing the issue you encountered and attaching the log file.
[/olist]
Thanks so much for helping us troubleshoot some of these annoyingly persistent bugs! We hope to take care of them ASAP using the data you provide.

Regards,
The [i]Sprint Vector[/i] devs

notes.title: Racing with the Stars: Sprint Vector v1.1 Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/a1d93663ca6e60613e98714702292cfd93cc6129.png[/img]

Ladies and gentlemen, beasts and monsters, the moment you’ve been waiting for is finally upon us…the first [i]Sprint Vector[/i] content update has officially landed! You can download [i]Racing with the Stars (Sprint Vector v1.1)[/i] right now.

What makes this free update so special, you ask? Why, you finally get the chance of a lifetime: you can now race as Sprint Vector‘s own charismatic master of ceremonies Mr. Entertainment! Oh, and his snarky-but-gorgeous sidekick-slash-makeup maven Princess Shran, too. But you’d better be ready to perform before you step into their vector blades–you know they won’t be able to hold back if you can’t sprint (or at least trash-talk) with the best of them!

Along with these two new playable characters, v1.1. also brings a host of updates to multiplayer stability so you can concentrate on the course, not your computer/console. Here are the patch notes:

[u][b]Patch Notes for Update 1.1 (released March 8, 2018)[/b][/u]
[*][b]Two New Playable Characters[/b] – You can now race as two additional selectable characters: [i]Sprint Vector[/i] hosts Mr. Entertainment and Princess Shran! Both characters, plus four skins each, are fully available to the player immediately at launch.
[*][b]Improved Server Stability[/b] – Implements several improvements to server stability and performance optimizations to improve multiplayer experience.
[*][b]Issue Logging for End Users[/b] – Log data will now be automatically generated. Logs can be found at C:\Users\*username*\AppData\Local\SprintVector\Saved\Logs (you’ll need to enable “Show hidden files, folders, and drives” in your File Explorer Options). Please email them to support@survios.com to help us troubleshoot!
[*][b]Improved AI Pathing[/b] – Implements multiple fixes to AI racer behavior throughout several race maps so that they better emulate the behavior of human players.
[*][b]Audio[/b] – Characters’ flying sound effects will no longer follow them into the race completion zone.

[*][b]Empty Power-Up Ball[/b] – This build decreases the probability of players not receiving an item when they run through a power-up.
[*][b]Finish Line Teleportation[/b] – This build fixes an issue where players would occasionally not finish the race and teleport to the completion area after crossing the finish line.
[*][b]General Graphical Performance[/b] – This patch contains several assorted improvements to graphical improvements on low- and mid-spec hardware.
[*][b]General Stability Improvements[/b] – This patch contains several assorted improvements to server and application stability.
[/list]

21 maps, 8-player racing, multiple game modes...[i]Sprint Vector[/i] is GO! [b][i]Sprint Vector[/i] officially launches February 8 for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift+Touch on Steam VR and Oculus Home[/b], with the PlayStation VR release slated for February 13.

Here's what's coming in the full release!
[list]
[*][b]Competitive multiplayer matches:[/b] Public and private online multiplayer modes pit up to eight players against each other in intense, high-speed races as you vie for a spot on the Global Leaderboards.
[*][b]12 competitive race tracks:[/b] Scale towering pyramids and plunge into alien ruins, leap across bottomless pits while dodging debilitating blobs of sludge, or survive the trap-riddled streets of an ancient city. A dozen complex race courses full of obstacles, alternate paths, and game-changing power-ups make for endless replay value.
[*][b]Customizable solo play:[/b] Run the course at your own pace and learn the ropes with customizable solo game settings.
[*][b]Nine challenge courses:[/b] Take on these diabolical courses designed to test your sprinting prowess to the extreme. Tackle three specific challenges across nine single-player challenge courses with Local and Global Leaderboards.
[*][b]Eight intergalactic competitors:[/b] Choose from eight colorful characters pulled from every corner of the galaxy, from notorious street artist Daxx to ethereal Luna to streetwise hammerhead Hendrix, each with multiple skins to unlock.
[*][b]Power-ups galore:[/b] Utilize a wide range of power-ups, from explosive proximity mines to nitro speed and racer-seeking rockets, to gain an advantage over the competition.
[/list]

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/382d28c437db6e14b1ccc75e35073dc6c8171be4.png[/img]

Greetings Vectorheads! The time has finally come, the moment you have waited for with bated breath, and we shall not keep you sweating with anticipation any longer. ːsteamhappyː Mr. Entertainment has declared that the [i]Sprint Vector[/i] closed beta for Vive and Oculus will take place [b]Friday, January 19, to Sunday, January 28![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/f8eb411ea0ee884e9a232f75834e8c527fc588ac.png[/img]

On weekends, we’ll be switching on our multiplayer servers from 5pm-8pm PST for US players and 17:00-20:00 GMT for EU players. (Outside of these hours, you’ll have single-player access to the Sprint Vector beta build for all three days--plenty of time to practice!)

Here’s what you can expect in this sneak peek of Sprint Vector’s latest crazy season: 
[list]
[*]Three competitive maps!
[*]Two never-before-seen solo challenge maps with three modes each!
[*]And most importantly...[b][i]8-player online races![/i][/b]
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29092977/ab55393a87b6e19a6f9e7832af88e1945f90abea.gif[/img]

Haven’t signed up? Fear not: we’re still accepting beta applications throughout the beta! Sign up at www.sprintvector.com/#beta and wait for further instructions via email.

Well, what are you waiting for?! Stretch out those shoulders, get that heart rate up, and prepare to face off--we’ll see you on Friday!
